date_role: Reported composition date; calendar not independently authenticated or converted.
coverage: Both delivered manuscript surfaces visually inspected at delivery resolution. Selected closing passage read directly; no full diplomatic transcription or independently reviewed translation.

findings.observation: Microscope and requested books are described in a chest entrusted to a named carrier; Oldenburg expresses confidence it has reached Hevelius.
findings.limit: Sender assurance, not an independently inspected recipient receipt or authenticated surviving object; not the small-distance instrument.

findings.reading: Oldenburg acknowledges Hevelius taking badly the long delay of an instrument for measuring small distances promised by Hooke. Hooke attributes delay to the press of business, promises fulfillment when possible, and Oldenburg says he will continue urging him.
findings.limit: Provisional direct reading, not a certified translation. Reported explanation and promise do not establish the true cause, delivery date or final fulfillment.

findings.observation: Letter includes a lunar-eclipse observation passage attributed to Hooke with September 8, 1671 heading and timed phases.
findings.limit: Copied report within correspondence, not an independently inspected Hooke original or calibrated trial of the delayed instrument. Numerical eclipse data not transcribed or modeled here.

findings.observation: Corrections, insertions and an entered-Letter-Book annotation are visible.
findings.limit: Draft/sent-copy status, hand identity, intervention dates, authenticity and continuous custody not independently established.

order_identity.reason: Similar small-distance function and Hooke connection support a follow-up, but no order number, part identification, dimensions or explicit1667commission cross-reference is established.
